result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the promotional banner has a serious contrast failure: its headline and subtext are white on a very pale mint background and are almost unreadable. No other clear visual defects were found; the clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom are expected scrolling behaviour.

issues.description: The promo banner's headline ('3 free deliveries for you') and subtext ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') are white on a very light mint-green background. The text is almost invisible, so the offer and promo code are effectively unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text colour (e.g. dark green or near-black) on the light banner, or darken the banner background to a saturated green so the white text meets WCAG contrast of at least 4.5:1.
